item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description:
0.9.0

  • Redesigned onboarding: a monochrome look matching the app icon, a new intro screen, and a permission step that opens System Settings directly and notices the grant on its own.
  • Redesigned stats popover with an animated donut and a native trend chart.
  • More visible menu bar icon: new Logo, Symbol and "+ dictation share" styles, and a higher-contrast default.
  • The "Erinnert" tab now counts only reminders that were actually shown.
  • The app starts in your Mac's language; you can still pick another one in Settings.
